entry_state: Bank group relationships, parent cash, permitted transfers and regulatory measures require distinct evidence and dates. Debt carrying values, maturities and guarantees are different populations; the next pages must identify contractual payment rights.
exit_state: Payment defaults, remedies and succession need dated contractual events. Loan creation differs from external cash settlement; allowance populations and prudential capital differ from accounting totals. The synthetic bank now begins a rule-bounded allowance and exposure reconciliation.
findings: The 2025 filing repeats a 2024 principal date for the callable notes; the text correctly declines to supply a 2025 year-end balance.
Payment default, elapsed cure periods, acceleration, individual payment rights, collective remedies and succession remain separate events. Original indenture and supplements remain uninspected.
The single-horizon EAD times PD times LGD calculation defines fixed exposure and conditional mean loss before use; its 0.8 to 2 change does not claim standard compliance.
Contractual commitments, methodology population, allowance and carrying value have distinct meanings. Expected loans at a future closing are not loans owned at the reporting date.
The fictional bank balances at net assets 138.6 and liabilities plus equity 138.6; a runoff of 40 leaves 9 unpaid under the stated cash and facility limit. No unlimited funding is introduced.
No new defect observed; the section 11.2 and prudential subsection continue beyond this segment.

equation.exposition_role: Illustrative single-horizon expected-loss identity under stated assumptions.
equation.symbols_units_domain: L and fixed EAD are currency amounts; PD and conditional mean LGD are fractions.
equation.assumptions_timing: One horizon, fixed exposure and no discounting.
equation.source_and_equality: Local demonstration with the assumptions stated in the preceding sentence.
equation.interpretation: Probability and conditional severity convert exposure to expected currency loss.
